newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Komercni picks Deutsche, Merrill Lynch for Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Komercni picks Deutsche, Merrill Lynch for Eurobond.

text.p: The Czech bank Komercni Banka a.s. said on Tuesday it had awarded the mandate to arrange a 300 million mark three-year Eurobond issue to U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch and Germany's Deutsche Bank AG.
The bonds, expected to be launched after a roadshow on September 23 and 24 in London and Frankfurt, are expected to carry a floating coupon, Komercni said.

The issue is the second Eurobond issue for the largest Czech commercial bank. The first came in April 1996, a $250 million, five-year issue, which was the initial Eurobond offered by any commercial bank in central and eastern Europe.
Komercni said it aimed to widen the spectrum of its financial sources from a circle of non-bank institutional investors.
